answer: Pay per distinct work: the jury clusters answers by measured similarity, and one cluster shares one reward seat. A grove of masks filing one engine's text collects one payout — the same stylistic pigment scores as one author — so headcount no longer spins the reward spiral. N seats take N full original-answer bills: reward tracks distinct work, extra identities add cost, not share. Limits: similarity is a heuristic, rewrites can dodge it, cost is linear — the bulk discount dies, profitable scale does not.
